dedup.prior: Feature09 and accepted itemcf-hyp001-refinement already specify F0=B+history_n+supported_pairs+defined_fraction versus F1=F0+mean. This adds a shared finite D control, not a new ItemCF family, grid or extractor contract.
dedup.limit_043: round-043.md is RetailRocket transfer and is not used as ItemCF evidence; the tried brainstorm-wave043-synthesis.md path does not exist. Accepted ItemCF refinement/local-acceptance documents supply substantive priors. No novelty over043 is claimed.

four_fields.mechanism: Both support-controlled arms receive the same predeclared finite degree/activity block D; only itemcf_mean differs.
four_fields.prediction: Any incremental effect attributed to mean must survive the D-augmented control on the same future cohort. Failure of a predeclared utility rule leaves degree/support explanation viable; the contrast does not condition on every possible degree function.
four_fields.nearest_finite_experiment: UNRUN separately reserved future two-fit F0/F1 comparison after exact source/support/cost readiness, preserving051 view-only semantics and excluding current final reuse.
four_fields.task1_benefit: Avoid crediting compatibility for popularity/activity effects and preserve a strong specified boosting control before spending rare purchase feedback.

D_exact_proposal.candidate: Own-excluded distinct view audience degree at the original daily snapshot.
D_exact_proposal.history: Unweighted mean and maximum own-excluded audience degree over the exact retained candidate-specific history; preserve diagonal exclusion before cap20/refill.
D_exact_proposal.query_activity: Distinct viewed-item count of query actor in graph snapshot, not raw duplicate count or a new all-action graph.
D_exact_proposal.missing: Same original history_n, supported_pairs and defined_fraction in both arms; explicit NULL/cold/no-history flags for D. Zero-support cases retained.
D_exact_proposal.semantic_dedup: Reuse semantically identical B/W fields where available; aliases do not create extra opportunities.
D_exact_proposal.scope_limit: Finite control only. Complete per-pair intersections plus degrees mathematically determine normalized similarity; incremental gains over controls containing all those inputs would be representation gains, not additional raw information.

literal.scope: Invented definition/algebra witness, no matrix or fixture constructed.
literal.query_actor: 0 has one past h view; own subtraction restores external h degree4. Every external actor has view degree3.
literal.timing: All external views and query view are inside strict-past graph/history windows; no anchor peers or future events.
literal.candidate_legality: Two balanced past purchases of a and b by a separate actor can supply popular-source candidates. Query recent h may also remain in unchanged C; purchases never enter the view-only graph.
literal.equal_inputs: d_a=d_b=d_h=4; history_n=1; supported_pairs=1 and defined_fraction=1 for both; equal query activity and external audience-user degree3.
literal.opposite_outcomes: The identical past may precede target{a} or target{b}. Toy separation proves neither positive expected NDCG nor causal preference.

future_control.F1: Exact F0+itemcf_mean only; no max/lift/window/threshold/shrinkage grid.
future_control.matched: Identical source/Q/C/fullY/history/availability/maturity/weights/settings/prefix selector/fixed seed; early train rows use past snapshots, never final full-train graph.
future_control.training: All mature nonempty-C training groups including all-negative groups retain existing1/|Cq| row mass. No support-only/positive-only resampling or new class reweighting.
future_control.assessment: All mature Q retained. Conditional query-macro NDCG uses every nonempty fullY, including off-C-only positives/emptyC; emptyY differs from censoring. Support slices are descriptive.
future_control.uncertainty: Paired same-Q contrast with declared repeated-user clustering; one sparse future block does not prove universal temporal robustness. Useful-effect threshold and Recall guard fixed before outcomes.
future_control.negative: Unmet decision rule means no admission. Negative point estimate or CI crossing0 does not prove equivalence; an appropriate prespecified upper bound below the declared useful-effect threshold could rule out that effect size. No refill/newseed/free retry.

cost.inner_feedback: At declared ceiling K, at most2K dependent prefix metric evaluations; full K training paid, no early-stop compute-saving claim.
cost.outer_feedback: Two model-role evaluations, one prespecified primary contrast; additional metrics/intervals/slices/readback itemized separately.
cost.full_preparation: Raw historical scans/warmup, binary membership/postings, expiry/cache, D lookups/summaries, exact requested intersections, full source/denominator coverage, oracle/readback, memory/spill, serialization/startup/failures/tails and fit/predict all paid.
cost.finite_request_bound: Existing100-query/220C/20history scope gives at most440000 requested pairs before cache, not a bound on source scan/postings memory/heavy-degree work or a new authorization.
